walkthroughs.body_html: For a non-rotating black hole, Rs ~ 3 km per solar mass. A 10 solar mass black hole has Rs ~ 30 km. Sagittarius A* (~4 million solar masses) has Rs ~ 12 million km.
A neutron star squeezes about 1.4 solar masses into a sphere ~20 km across. Density ~10^17 kg/m^3 — a sugar cube would weigh ~1 billion tonnes.
In 2015, LIGO detected gravitational waves from two merging black holes 1.3 billion light-years away — confirming a prediction of Einstein's general relativity.
